ski jumping = skiing down a ramp and jumping as far as possible
curling = a sport on ice in which teams slide stones towards a target
water polo = a team ball game played in a pool, similar to handball in water
synchronised swimming = a sport in which swimmers perform a routine of movements to music
orienteering = finding your way across country with a map and compass against the clock
show jumping = a riding event in which horse and rider jump a course of fences
snooker = a cue sport played with 21 balls on a large table, popular in Britain
netball = a team game similar to basketball, widely played in British schools
field hockey = a team game played with sticks and a ball on grass or artificial turf
rugby union = a 15-a-side rugby code with scrums, lineouts and tries worth five points
stadium = a large sports ground with seats around the playing area
pitch = the marked grass or turf area where football or rugby is played
court = the marked area for tennis, basketball, volleyball or squash
athletics track = the oval running surface used for track events
arena = a large indoor venue for sport or entertainment
velodrome = a track, often banked, designed for cycle racing
ice rink = an ice surface for skating, ice hockey or curling
ski slope = a prepared hillside used for skiing or snowboarding
golf course = an area of land with numbered holes for playing golf
sports hall = an indoor hall marked for several sports, often at a school
